description_zh: M3 未来活动预处理配置的唯一机器权威。所有 29-subject、移动端及外部 PTT benchmark 必须按精确 profile_id 解析，不允许以自由参数或旧根目录脚本替代。
description_en: Sole machine authority for future-active M3 preprocessing profiles. Every 29-subject, mobile and external-PTT benchmark must resolve an exact profile_id; free parameters and repository-root scripts are not substitutes.

profiles.description_zh: Frailty3 B/R 静态或恢复片段的离线零相位 PPG 前端；保留 0.2 Hz 以上缓慢生理变化，400 Hz 输入禁止重复重采样。
profiles.description_en: Offline zero-phase PPG front end for Frailty3 B/R static or recovery segments; retains slow physiology above 0.2 Hz and forbids repeated resampling of 400 Hz input.

profiles.description_zh: Frailty3 S/W 运动片段的离线零相位 PPG 前端；0.4 Hz 高通抑制慢漂移，但 raw DC/AC 另行保留用于 SQI 与幅值特征。
profiles.description_en: Offline zero-phase PPG front end for Frailty3 S/W motion segments; the 0.4 Hz high-pass suppresses slow drift while raw DC/AC remains available for SQI and amplitude features.

profiles.description_zh: 离线峰检测门面的唯一 Frailty3 输入配置；仅该 purpose 可传给 detect_peaks_corrected 的 profile-locked 适配层。
profiles.description_en: Sole Frailty3 input profile for the offline peak facade; only this purpose may enter the profile-locked detect_peaks_corrected adapter.

profiles.description_zh: 未来低质量/运动片段 denoiser 的离线输入配置；不代表任何 denoiser 已经通过 benchmark。
profiles.description_en: Offline input profile for a future low-quality/motion denoiser; it does not claim that any denoiser has passed a benchmark.

profiles.description_zh: 弃用兼容别名，仅指向 mobile_motion_ppg_400_causal_v1；新 benchmark 禁止直接使用。
profiles.description_en: Deprecated compatibility alias pointing only to mobile_motion_ppg_400_causal_v1; direct use is forbidden in new benchmarks.

profiles.description_zh: 移动端 B/R 静态或恢复片段的因果有状态配置；与离线静态路线保持 0.2–8 Hz 语义，但不冒充零相位等价。
profiles.description_en: Causal stateful mobile profile for B/R static or recovery segments; preserves the offline static 0.2–8 Hz semantics without claiming zero-phase equivalence.

profiles.description_zh: 移动端 S/W 运动片段的因果有状态配置；是旧 mobile_ppg_400_causal_v1 的唯一迁移目标。
profiles.description_en: Causal stateful mobile profile for S/W motion segments; the sole migration target of the old mobile_ppg_400_causal_v1 alias.

profiles.description_zh: 移动端峰检测门面的因果输入配置；峰 facade 只允许本配置或 frailty3_peak_ppg_400_offline_v1。
profiles.description_en: Causal input profile for the mobile peak facade; the facade accepts only this profile or frailty3_peak_ppg_400_offline_v1.

profiles.description_zh: 外部 PTT PPG 的唯一未来活动重采样配置；256/500 Hz 到 400 Hz 必须使用 SciPy resample_poly，信号、时间、mask 与峰标注共享同一索引映射。
profiles.description_en: Sole future-active external-PTT resampling profile; 256/500 Hz to 400 Hz uses SciPy resample_poly and one shared mapping for signal, time, masks and peak annotations.

profiles.description_zh: 校正后的动态加速度 raw8 视图；与旧 sequence_8ch_v1 语义不兼容，必须在 M4 重新训练分类器。
profiles.description_en: Corrected dynamic-acceleration raw8 view; semantically incompatible with legacy sequence_8ch_v1 and therefore requires M4 classifier retraining.

profiles.description_zh: D5 冻结的无预校准四元数误差状态 EKF 主路线；显式 SI 单位、就绪门、NIS 门和无静默 LPF 回退。
profiles.description_en: D5-frozen no-precalibration quaternion error-state EKF primary route with explicit SI units, readiness/NIS gates and no silent LPF fallback.

profiles.description_zh: D5 的 0.3 Hz 二阶低通重力分量对照路线；只用于与 EKF 对称比较，不得静默替代 EKF。
profiles.description_en: D5 second-order 0.3 Hz low-pass gravity comparator; used for symmetric comparison with EKF and never as a silent EKF substitute.

profiles.description_zh: 仅用于复现历史 heartbeat 256 Hz 行为；禁止进入未来 benchmark。
profiles.description_en: Only for reproducing historical 256 Hz heartbeat behavior; forbidden in future benchmarks.

profiles.description_zh: 仅用于复现历史 hybrid 500 Hz 行为；禁止进入未来 benchmark。
profiles.description_en: Only for reproducing historical 500 Hz hybrid behavior; forbidden in future benchmarks.
